checks.assessment: C validates the local live owner, armed/pending state, slot and Job, duplicates/stores/type-checks the actual newly created process handle before the fallible PG_CheckArmed policy callback. Python created_registration skips only pre-capture freshness callbacks and performs info/source/witness checks after C capture; an error poisons rather than permits resume.

Host-only state directory/file DACLs are supplied and checked, source/DLL handles are held, original handles/file identities and exact bytes are checked, exclusive slot/name/SID/key/context files are created and WriteFile plus FlushFileBuffers are required. Journal/context are never loaded into removal authority; no prior owner identity is adopted or reused. A current .lock is used only to serialize reservations.

Begin-create pending state precedes actual creation; suspended process capture and live source/token/policy checks precede resume. The live C owner and retained original process/Job duplicates, sealed launches, fresh empty/signalled checks and actual policy removal/readback govern removal. Persisted JSON, PID absence and earlier saved zero counts cannot authorize it.

Failure paths poison the live guard. Profile/ACL cleanup remains gated by live verified authority and accumulated cleanup errors; legacy nonpersistent behavior is retained. Abandonment closes local held resources without reconstructing/removing orphan policy or identity. A late failure may leave already removed policy removed while reporting full cleanup false; no recreation claim is made.

Default build-null stays separate. sid-canary reruns the changed DLL NULL ABI before creating one live guard, then reuses the fixed TCP normal/cancel cases. Only explicit WSA10013 counts as denial; timeout, unknown, nonzero exit, missing child/token/cancel or cleanup evidence remains failure. Native/installer/product support remain false regardless of success.

Existing 30-second setup/Job enclosure, 150-second controller witness, 170-second parent, 3-minute CI, fixed role image caps and existing process/output controls remain. State has bounded slots/entries/bytes/records; projection is restricted to at most nine exclusively created names, 64KiB each and 128KiB total, with 32KiB encoded chunks. No timeout increase or completion shortcut added in this change.

_owned_names is initialized empty and populated only after successful CREATE_NEW, before writes. material_snapshot reads only those names, includes actual bytes/SHA/base64, and separately tests against last complete tracked writes. Missing/partial/different material is explicit and makes the readiness result fail. Readiness emits bounded metadata plus encoded chunks and excludes base64 from the bounded JSON report. This is diagnostic retention, never cleanup authority.

Externally supplied source/protocol hashes, exact stage-specific source census, held source/protocol files and final fresh witness bind the prospective mode. State adds all ten absolute runtime source pins and the newly built DLL. The final JSON remains bounded; unavailable state construction or failed resource/report operations cannot produce a successful result.
